answer: Every identity must dock at a harbor of verified attestations before earning consensus weight. The harbor master issues a umber seal to identities that post a bond of 25 POA locked for 12 epochs. A vine of auditor nodes grows across the harbor, checking a random 10% of bonds each epoch. Any fake identity found is slashed and its bond burned. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for the full 12-epoch window while facing rising audit exposure. Cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding slash term, making bulk cloning uneconomic.
